excluded: Session development v1/v2 and first confirmation: mutable fixture reads returned pre-write content. Their utility and cost comparisons are invalid. Corrected stateful reruns replace them.
Skill development before v3: original mutable read behavior or incomplete provider-limited run. Not used for conclusions.
Initial suggestion grader v1/v2/v3 misinterpreted candidate speaker or evidence; revised grading replaces those scores.
One reasoning diagnostic family refers to absent subject lines above. All 30 trials remain for timing diagnostics but are uncertain and excluded from utility comparisons.
decisions: Retain the production suggestion prompt and no-reasoning setting. Neither compressed finalist passes confirmation.
Do not replace the shared base globally. Researcher/session fixture gains do not cover routing, hosted search, repository context, browser tools, or production integration.
Retain the full sample skill over its compact candidate; the compact version increases total tokens and misses workflow steps.
Retire used confirmation cases into challenge/regression data. New candidate selection requires new confirmation families.
limits: Authoring and auditing by an agent can share biases with the tested and grading models.
Few authored role/skill families are pilot evidence, not representative production samples.
Bootstrap intervals describe these families; repeated trials do not increase independent family counts.
Priority tier was requested but provider responses reported default; latency is observed model-loop timing, not promised tier or end-to-end UI latency.
No Chinese instruction compression, alternate model families, real browser/service work, or renderer validation was established.
